reviews.review: If you can't enjoy this game, you just don't like fun.Edit after playing twice as many hours as before:Game still fun.

First, the caveats: (1) I've spent just over two hours with the title, and (2) I definitely paid too much for it. I bought it for $35.99 when the hype machine was turned up all the way and lots of people were praising the title. The reviews are all still very positive I see, so I'm going to try to give you a balanced viewpoint despite the aforementioned caveats.

Here's the crux of it: if you're seeking a mindless bug shooter with some interesting flexibility in classes, weapons, and equipment, and you don't mind an overwrought story and what seems like shaky translations and porting choices, then this is a game you're probably going to like. To be fair, I like it for what it is; I just didn't really understand going into it and probably should have tried it sooner and requested a refund.

It's just not my thing. I like casual brain-dead shooting sometimes, but this one [i]really[/i] puts the dead in brain-dead. I don't think I've even had to try on any of the missions. I run around shooting virtually everything that moves, running over pickups, and it's like its an enemy invasion of loot pinatas. I can't take the bugs seriously when I'm not sure I've ever been hit by anything in the first twelve missions.

Candy Crush would provide more of a challenge. And again, I'm not all about the challenge, I've played games like this before, but my suggestion for you is that the title is really worth more like $20. You'll spend a few hours shooting stuff, maybe relaxing with your beverage of choice, and then you'll be bored, at least if you're like me. My suggestion is that unless you absolutely love the hokey sci-fi invasion B-movies from the 1950s and simply can't get enough, your money and your time are likely better spent elsewhere.

It's EDF, that's all there's to know.
Interesting weapons seem to come later than in 4.1 in this one, not a fan of that.
Great successor to EDF 4.1.  Less "joke" weapons and more levels that the prequel, it is best played with friends, so you can all scream about giant bugs and make fun of the campy story dialogue.
